info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Sub Custodian Agreement Retrieval API
info.description: The Sub Custodian Agreement Retrieval API allows users to access detailed information about sub custodian agreements managed by external agencies. This API serves as a vital resource for financial institutions and legal teams needing to review or audit existing agreements. Consumers include compliance officers and legal analysts who require up-to-date documentation for regulatory purposes. By leveraging this API, users can efficiently retrieve agreement data linked to specific parameters, thereby streamlining their operational workflows.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific sub-custodian agreement by its ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch details for a specific sub-custodian agreement identified by its unique ID. It provides all relevant information related to the agreement, which can be utilized in both reporting and compliance checks.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the sub-custodian agreement details for the specified resource identifier RES-100045. It expects the input in JSON format and adheres to the defined schema.

200.description: Successful retrieval of the requested sub-custodian agreement details.

GetSubCustodianAgreementByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the operations related to the external agency sub-custodian agreement, conforming to the application/json media type.
